title: Cleanup: when exactly does it run?

slides.say: Your effect can return a function. React calls it cleanup. But when does it run?
The setup connects to the room. The returned function, the cleanup, disconnects from it.

slides.text: React calls cleanup before the Effect runs again, and one last time on unmount.
slides.say: React calls your cleanup each time before the effect runs again, and one final time when the component is removed.

slides.text:
roomId: general → travel
1. connect general
2. disconnect general
3. connect travel
slides.say: So if the room changes from general to travel, React first disconnects from general, using the old value, then connects to travel.
Rule of thumb: whatever setup starts, cleanup should stop or undo.
